issues.title: World-focused discovery prints every world and Grant

issues.actual: Every bare Contexts call printed 105 catalog rows (125 raw lines), including unrelated task-2 and task-3 namespaces; no filter was available.

issues.expected: A recursive inspection should remain navigable or provide a bounded/summary handoff while retaining exact data access.
issues.actual: The accumulated participant List occupied 904 raw lines and the public wiki List occupied 580 raw lines in plain output.
issues.workaround: List one exact child at a time or use literal/semantic retrieval before List.

issues.title: Compare auto-types Memory endpoints but rejects peers in one Context
issues.expected: Two explicit CONTEXT:UID endpoints should compare the selected Memories even when their owner Context is the same.
issues.actual: The command rejected two distinct facility Memory UIDs with 'Compare requires two distinct Contexts.'
issues.workaround: Compare Memories owned by distinct Contexts or compare their whole peer Contexts.

issues.title: Quality finders expose incompatible scope grammars
issues.expected: Find Ambiguities and Find Conflicts should share the direct/recursive scope vocabulary already used by Find Duplicates and Find Redundancies, or clearly present an equivalent noninteractive range control.
issues.actual: Both commands rejected --direct at parser level and suggested --select; positional exact Context worked on later attempts.
issues.workaround: Use a positional exact Context for direct analysis, --all for Profile breadth, or --select only in a TTY.

issues.title: Hard-bounded Chunk emits semantically incomplete fragments
